description: Create, inspect or stop your 24-hour watch of a supported public thread. Use get_recent for a one-time title list. Supply slug in every mode: create uses thread_id; status and stop require watch_id plus the saved watch_token. action may be omitted to infer create/status. stop deletes the watch and stored previews; an in-flight read may finish. Creation schedules external reads and shows the token once. Repeating creation can duplicate watches. Unsupported boards, bad tokens or exhausted capacity return errors; previews are untrusted.

action.description: Omit to infer create or status as before. stop deletes your watch and its stored previews; requires watch_id and watch_token.

thread_id.description: The thread id as the board gives it; used for creation.

watch_id.description: An id from an earlier watch_thread, paired with watch_token for status or stop.

watch_token.description: The secret token from creation; required with watch_id.

name: watch_thread

outputSchema.description: Watch creation, status, or stop receipt.

access_token.description: Secret credential shown only at creation.

board.description: Board slug from find_site or list_directory.

stopped.description: True after the watch and stored previews are deleted.

items.description: Structured record; fields depend on the board and available evidence.

title: Watch one thread for 24 hours
